faults.title: Units available tile counts the catalogue as 40 units
faults.manifestation: The Units available tile on the desk overview reads "40" with the note "of 40 units in the catalogue". The note is supposed to state the catalogue's total unit count, which is 53, so the tile now claims the desk owns only the units that happen to be free.
faults.trigger_path: Open the desk overview at / and read the Units available tile and its note.

faults.title: Late business days counted from the day before the due date
faults.manifestation: The Overdue loans table on the desk overview says L-1042 is 4 business days late with a late fee today of $60.00. R8 counts the business days after the Wed 11 Mar due date up to the desk date — Thu 12, Fri 13 and Mon 16, three days — for a $45.00 fee on three units. The same inflated day count and fee follow through to the loan page's check-in notice and to the check-in banner.
faults.trigger_path: Open / and read the Business days late and Late fee today columns of the Overdue loans table, or open /loans/L-1042 and read the line above the check-in form.

faults.title: Late fees taken today never reach charges booked today
faults.manifestation: Checking the overdue loan L-1042 in charges a $45.00 late fee and says so in the banner, but the desk overview's Charges booked today tile stays at $341.00 instead of moving to $386.00. A fee charged at the desk today is silently missing from the day's takings.
faults.trigger_path: Read Charges booked today on /, check L-1042 in with condition Good from /loans/L-1042, then return to / and read the tile again.

faults.title: Unknown catalogue item is refused with the loans sentence
faults.manifestation: Opening an equipment address that does not exist shows the "Something went wrong" page with the error banner "That loan does not exist." The address is an equipment item, and the required sentence is "That equipment item does not exist."
faults.trigger_path: Open /equipment/no-such-item (or follow any broken equipment link) and read the error banner.

faults.title: Available now only filters nothing
faults.manifestation: Ticking "Available now only" and pressing Apply filters changes nothing: all 12 items stay listed, "Showing 12 of 12 equipment items." is unchanged, and the DJI RS 4 Pro Gimbal is still there with its "Fully booked" pill — while the checkbox stays ticked and the URL carries availableOnly=1. The desk overview's Units available tile leads to the same unfiltered list.
faults.trigger_path: Open /equipment, tick Available now only, press Apply filters; or click the Units available tile on /.

faults.title: The Out status filter hides overdue loans
faults.manifestation: Filtering the loans list by status Out lists 2 loans and says "Showing 2 of 8 loans.", leaving out the overdue loan L-1042 even though its status is out. The desk overview's Out on loan tile says 3 and links straight to this list.
faults.trigger_path: Open /loans, choose Status "Out", press Apply filters; or click the Out on loan tile on /.

faults.title: Cancel loan is offered nowhere
faults.manifestation: No loan offers a Cancel loan button any more. L-1043, waiting on the pickup shelf, shows only Mark picked up, and the two awaiting-approval requests show only Go to approvals, so a booking can never be withdrawn and its units never go back into stock before pickup.
faults.trigger_path: Open /loans/L-1043 or /loans/L-1044 and look at the action panel for Cancel loan.

faults.title: A loan can be extended more than once
faults.manifestation: After L-1048 has been extended once, its Schedule panel says "One 7-day extension used" while the Extension block still says "One extension is allowed." with an enabled Extend by 7 days button. Pressing it again is accepted and pushes the due date another seven days, instead of refusing with "This loan has already used its one extension."
faults.trigger_path: Open /loans/L-1048, press Extend by 7 days, then press it again on the reloaded page. Reachable only once f-extension-block-missing is withdrawn.

faults.title: Three units miss the bundle discount
faults.manifestation: A loan of exactly three units earns no bundle discount: step 3 shows no "Bundle discount (3+ units)" line and a total 10% too high — three GoPro Hero 12 kits for 7 days come to $126.00 instead of $113.40. Four or more units still discount correctly, and the seeded three-unit loan L-1042 keeps its stored $23.10 discount.
faults.trigger_path: New loan → step 1 → step 2: add 3 units of one item (GoPro Hero 12 ×3), loan period 7 days → Continue to review, and read the Charges panel.

faults.title: A Saturday due date rolls forward only one day
faults.manifestation: A due date that lands on a Saturday is moved forward one day to the Sunday instead of two days to the Monday, so the desk promises a return on a day it is closed. Booking a 1-day loan for pickup Fri 20 Mar 2026 shows Due back "Sun 22 Mar 2026, 17:00" on step 3 and on the booked loan; R3 makes it Mon 23 Mar 2026. Extensions that land on a Saturday move the same wrong way.
faults.trigger_path: New loan → step 2: any item, loan period 1 day, pickup date 2026-03-20 → Continue to review and read Due back.
